reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "CompositionRevision v1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.mode`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: CompositionRevision resources with spec.mode: Resources will be rejected by the API server.

proposed.statement: The "Resources" enum value for spec.mode in CompositionRevision v1 schema was removed; existing resources with this value will be rejected by the API server.
